preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Contract must have users with token balances

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero. This will lock all user transfers (except owner transfers) because the _transfer function requires amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner senders/recipients. Users will be unable to transfer any tokens while the owner can still transfer freely.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The WEB3 contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxPercent() that allows the owner to set _maxTxAmount to any value, including 0. When _maxTxAmount is 0, all non-owner transfers will fail because the transfer validation requires amount > 0 and amount <= _maxTxAmount. This is an owner privilege abuse where the owner can freeze all transfers in the contract.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to 0, demonstrating the owner's ability to manipulate this critical parameter.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Identify the current owner of the contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call setMaxTxPercent(0) on the WEB3 contract. 4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now 0.
